sentiment.summary: No actionable sentiment signal for SHY; congressional activity is stale (2+ years old), market sentiment is balanced between bearish and neutral, and news data unavailable.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (179.84) combined with inverted yield curve signals severe systemic stress; SHY (short-duration bonds) offers relative safety but macro backdrop is highly unfavourable for risk assets.

debate.key_bull_argument: Supertrend bullish, Ichimoku above cloud, and OBV bullish provide technical confluence; price at support (72.4654) with stochastic at extreme low (3.31) offers potential mean-reversion entry if macro stress eases.
